The read-later list is in. Refresh **http://maker:4001** — you'll see **All** and **Read Later** tabs near the top.

Let's try it:

> **1.** On the "10 Usability Heuristics" card, click **Read later**. A little orange **Read later** badge appears on the card, and the count on the **Read Later** tab ticks up.
> **2.** Click the **Read Later** tab. You should now see only the bookmarks you've marked — your separate reading list.
> **3.** Your search and tag filters still work inside this view, so you can find things within your read-later list too.
> **4.** Switch back to **All**.

One decision here I specifically want your call on, because it changes the behaviour:

- I made **Read later** an *additional marker* — the bookmark still lives in your main **All** library, and also appears in the **Read Later** list. The alternative would be to *move* it out of All so it only shows under Read Later until you've read it. Which matches how you think of your read-later list — a bookmark that's **also** flagged for reading, or one that's **set aside** out of the main list?

Also — I put the **All / Read Later** switch as tabs across the top. Does reaching your read-later list that way feel natural?

Give it a try and tell me your preference on that marker-vs-move question.
